name: alibaba/wan/2.7/video-extend
description: Alibaba Wan 2.7 Video Extend continues an input clip from a text instruction, optionally ending on a chosen last frame, for a total length of up to 15 seconds.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed (0-2147483647) for reproducible results. Omit for a random seed.

video.title: Video
video.description: URL of the source clip to continue (MP4 or MOV, 2-10 seconds, 240-4096px per side, up to 100MB).

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: A girl takes a selfie in the mirror, then picks up her backpack and walks out of the room.
prompt.description: What happens after the source clip ends: action, camera movement, scene progression, and sound. Up to 5,000 characters.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Total length of the output in seconds, including the source clip (2-15). For a 3-second source and duration 10, the model adds 7 seconds. Must be longer than the source clip.

end_image.title: End Image
end_image.description: Optional last frame the continuation should end on (JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WebP; 240-8000px per side, up to 20MB).

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the video to generate.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Wan 2.7 Video Extend

Continue an existing clip. Wan 2.7 picks up from the last frame of `video` and generates new footage that follows your prompt; add `end_image` to say where the continuation should land.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 5,000 characters. |
| `video` | video URL, required | — | Clip to continue. |
| `end_image` | image URL | — | Optional frame the new footage should end on. |
| `duration` | 2–15 | 5 | Length of the new footage in seconds. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `seed` | integer 0–2147483647 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds: $0.10 at 720p and $0.15 at 1080p, the same as Alibaba's list price. Only the new footage is billed.

| New footage | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 2s | $0.20 | $0.30 |
| 5s (default) | $0.50 | $0.75 |
| 10s | $1.00 | $1.50 |
| 15s | $1.50 | $2.25 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe what happens next, not what is already in the clip.
- Match the source's camera style unless you want a deliberate change.
- Use `end_image` when the shot must finish on a specific composition.

## Limits

- The returned video contains the continuation; join it to the source in your editor if you need one file.

## Also on SandBase

Other Wan 2.7 endpoints: `alibaba/wan/2.7/text-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/reference-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/video-edit`, `alibaba/wan/3.0/video` (newer, up to 30s).
